title: American Airlines' pilots union says Spirit's data sale to Google could undermine aviation safety
text: The union representing American Airlines pilots objected this week to Spirit's data sale to Google. The union cited privacy and safety concerns and joined prior objections to the sale.

title: I Sold NVIDIA, Google and Microsoft Over a $2 Trillion AI Gap. Was I Wrong?
text: A Reddit investor walked away from three of the biggest AI trade names in the market, armed with math showing the economics simply do not add up. Whether his timing was brilliant or costly depends on a gap that Bain and Company puts even higher than he did.
